what-is-loftlancer.title: What is Loftlancer?
what-is-loftlancer.summary: Loftlancer is a planning, validation, and delivery workspace for freelance software builders—not a website builder or a coding agent.

sections.heading: Purpose
paragraphs: Loftlancer helps you turn vague client ideas into explicit scope, client-approved plans, and agent-ready work orders before you write production code.
It keeps client expectations, your plan, and implementation aligned through handover.

sections.heading: What it is not
paragraphs: Loftlancer does not host arbitrary websites, replace your IDE, or auto-generate full products without your judgment.
You stay in control of architecture, estimates, and delivery.

create-your-account.title: Create your account
create-your-account.summary: Sign up with a supported provider to access Studio, Console, and organization features.

sections.heading: Sign-up options
paragraphs: Use GitHub, Google (when enabled for your region), or a passwordless email magic link.
Pick your preferred locale during onboarding; you can change it later in account settings.

sections.heading: After sign-up
paragraphs: You land in the auth app to complete your profile and create or join an organization.
Free Starter plans are available without a payment method.

passwordless-sign-in.title: Passwordless sign-in
passwordless-sign-in.summary: Loftlancer uses Better Auth for secure, passwordless access.

sections.heading: Magic links
paragraphs: Enter your email on the sign-in page. We send a one-time link via Resend; open it on the same device within the expiry window.
Links are single-use. Request a new link if yours expired.

sections.heading: Social sign-in
paragraphs: GitHub and Google sign-in use OAuth. We store only the identifiers needed to authenticate you.
You can link multiple providers from account security settings when available.

switch-locale.title: Switch locale
switch-locale.summary: Loftlancer supports en-us, en-in, and es-es across marketing, auth, Studio, and Console.

sections.heading: Marketing site
paragraphs: Use the locale switcher in the site header or visit paths prefixed with /en-us, /en-in, or /es-es.
Your choice is stored in a locale cookie for return visits.

sections.heading: Signed-in apps
paragraphs: Change language under Account → Preferences. App chrome and emails respect your selected locale where translations exist.

create-organization.title: Create an organization
create-organization.summary: Organizations are the billing and collaboration boundary for client work.

sections.heading: Who should create one
paragraphs: Freelancers and small agencies typically create one organization per business entity.
You can belong to multiple organizations with different roles.

sections.heading: Steps
paragraphs: From Studio or Console, open the organization switcher and choose Create organization.
Name your workspace and invite teammates after creation if you are on a plan that includes seats.

invite-teammates.title: Invite teammates
invite-teammates.summary: Bring collaborators into your organization with role-based access.

sections.heading: Invitations
paragraphs: Organization owners and managers can send email invitations from organization settings.
Invitees accept through the auth app and are added with the role you assign.

sections.heading: Seat limits
paragraphs: Paid plans include a fixed number of seats. Upgrade or remove inactive members if you reach the limit.

organization-roles.title: Organization roles
organization-roles.summary: Roles control who can change billing, invite members, and edit client projects.

sections.heading: Common roles
paragraphs: Owner: full control including billing and deletion.
Manager: can invite members and manage projects but may not transfer ownership.
Member: can work on assigned projects within plan limits.

sections.heading: Best practices
paragraphs: Keep ownership with the business entity that pays for the subscription.
Use the least privilege needed for contractors and clients.

free-vs-paid-plans.title: Free vs paid plans
free-vs-paid-plans.summary: Starter is free for solo builders; Pro and higher tiers add seats, projects, and priority support.

sections.heading: Starter
paragraphs: Includes limited active projects and seats suitable for validating Loftlancer with a single client.

sections.heading: Paid tiers
paragraphs: Paid plans unlock more projects, storage, API usage, and collaboration features. Compare limits on the pricing page before checkout.

subscribe-and-billing.title: Subscribe and billing
subscribe-and-billing.summary: Paid subscriptions are sold through Autumn and charged by Stripe.

sections.heading: Checkout
paragraphs: Choose monthly or yearly billing on the pricing page. Tax may apply based on your location.
Invoices and payment methods are managed in account billing settings.

sections.heading: Renewals
paragraphs: Subscriptions renew automatically until canceled. We email receipts for successful charges.

cancel-or-change-plan.title: Cancel or change plan
cancel-or-change-plan.summary: Upgrade, downgrade, or cancel from billing settings.

sections.heading: Upgrades
paragraphs: Upgrades apply immediately. Stripe may prorate the difference for the current period.

sections.heading: Downgrades and cancellation
paragraphs: Downgrades typically apply at period end so you keep paid features until then.
After cancellation, your organization reverts to Starter limits unless you resubscribe.

cookie-and-analytics-consent.title: Cookie and analytics consent
cookie-and-analytics-consent.summary: Essential cookies run the product; analytics load only with consent.

sections.heading: Essential cookies
paragraphs: Authentication, security, locale, and organization context require cookies and local storage.

sections.heading: Analytics
paragraphs: Google Analytics 4, PostHog, and Vercel Web Analytics load only after you accept analytics in the cookie banner or enable them in account privacy settings.

export-or-delete-data.title: Export or delete data
export-or-delete-data.summary: Exercise privacy rights from account settings or by emailing privacy@loftlancer.com.

sections.heading: In-product controls
paragraphs: Signed-in users can manage consents and request deletion under Account → Privacy & data at /auth/{locale}/account/privacy-data.
Export tooling may be limited during early access; contact privacy@loftlancer.com for manual export requests.

sections.heading: Retention
paragraphs: We retain billing and security records as required by law after account deletion.

magic-link-not-arriving.title: Magic link not arriving
magic-link-not-arriving.summary: Troubleshoot email delivery for passwordless sign-in.

sections.heading: Check spam and typos
paragraphs: Confirm the email address and search spam or promotions folders for mail from Loftlancer.

sections.heading: Rate limits and providers
paragraphs: Wait a few minutes before requesting another link. Corporate filters may block external mail—try a personal inbox or GitHub sign-in.

billing-checkout-issues.title: Billing checkout issues
billing-checkout-issues.summary: Resolve failed payments and Stripe checkout errors.

sections.heading: Card declines
paragraphs: Verify billing address, 3-D Secure, and that your bank allows international charges to Stripe.

sections.heading: Still stuck
paragraphs: Note the error message and time, then contact support with your organization name. Do not share full card numbers in email.

contact-support.title: Contact support
contact-support.summary: Reach the Loftlancer team for product, billing, and privacy questions.

sections.heading: Channels
paragraphs: Email support@loftlancer.com or use the public contact form.
Signed-in users can open support tickets under Account → Help & support.

sections.heading: Response times
paragraphs: We aim to respond on business days. Paid plans may include faster targets defined at checkout.

stillNeedHelp.title: Still need help?
stillNeedHelp.body: Contact us or open a support ticket if you are signed in.

faqItems.question: Is Loftlancer a website builder?
faqItems.answer: No. Loftlancer is a planning, validation, and delivery workspace. It helps you agree scope with clients and keep implementation aligned—it does not replace your hosting stack or IDE.

faqItems.question: How do I sign in without a password?
faqItems.answer: Use GitHub, Google, or an email magic link. Links are sent through Resend and expire after a short period.

faqItems.question: Can I work with teammates?
faqItems.answer: Yes. Create an organization, invite members, and assign roles. Seat limits depend on your plan.

faqItems.question: Where is billing handled?
faqItems.answer: Checkout uses Autumn and Stripe. Manage payment methods and invoices in account billing settings.

faqItems.question: How do I control analytics cookies?
faqItems.answer: Use the site cookie banner or, when signed in, Privacy & data → Consents at /auth/{locale}/account/privacy-data.

faqItems.question: What if my magic link does not arrive?
faqItems.answer: Check spam, verify your email, wait before retrying, or sign in with GitHub. See the troubleshooting article for more steps.

faqItems.question: Can I delete my account and data?
faqItems.answer: Yes. Use account deletion in Privacy & data or email privacy@loftlancer.com. Some billing records may be retained as required by law.

faqItems.question: Who operates Loftlancer?
faqItems.answer: Loftlancer is operated from India as a SaaS product. Support: support@loftlancer.com.

faqItems.question: Do you offer refunds?
faqItems.answer: See our Refund Policy at /legal/refund. Eligibility depends on timing and usage.

faqItems.question: How do I report a security issue?
faqItems.answer: Email security@loftlancer.com with details. See our Security page for responsible disclosure guidelines.

faqItems.question: Which languages are supported?
faqItems.answer: Marketing and apps support en-us, en-in, and es-es today.

aboutPage.description: We help freelance developers vibe plan before they vibe code.

sections.heading: Our mission
paragraphs: Loftlancer is the source of truth between client expectations, the freelancer, and implementation.
We are not another coding agent or a generic cloud platform.

paragraphs: Freelance software builders who need explicit scope, client validation, and delivery discipline.

sections.heading: How we operate
paragraphs: Loftlancer is offered as SaaS from India with infrastructure partners worldwide.
Questions: support@loftlancer.com.

accessibilityPage.metaDescription: Loftlancer accessibility commitment and WCAG-oriented practices.
accessibilityPage.title: Accessibility
accessibilityPage.description: We aim to make Loftlancer usable for freelance builders and their clients.

sections.heading: Commitment
paragraphs: We follow WCAG 2.2 Level AA as a target for marketing, auth, Studio, and Console.
We test keyboard navigation, focus order, color contrast, and screen reader labels on new work.

sections.heading: Feedback
paragraphs: Report barriers to support@loftlancer.com with the page URL and assistive technology you use.
